data.desc: Azul S.A. (B3: AZUL3; NYSE American: AZUL), the largest airline in Brazil by departures and cities served, offers approximately 800 daily flights to over 137 destinations. With an operating fleet of over 180 aircraft and more than 14,000 Crewmembers, the Company has a network of 250 non-stop routes. In 2020, Azul was awarded best airline in the world by TripAdvisor, first time a Brazilian Flag Carrier earns number one ranking in the Traveler's Choice Awards.
